_comment: The three *qps profiles above gate scripts/perf_test.sh and are unchanged. Their latency threshold is compared against an AVERAGE, not a percentile, because cmd/load_generator emits no percentiles -- see F-017 in docs/oss/findings.md. The bench_standard bounds below come from bench/run.sh, which measures real percentiles from every observation.

bench_standard._comment: Regression bounds for ./bench/run.sh --scale standard. Empty until a standard-scale run has been performed on a named reference machine; GRVX-1001 measures, and a threshold set from a single unreviewed run is not a baseline.
